text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Okay, it's all about positioning from here… I'll hold this position for a bit, and…)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's made a move from the inside! She's coming up from the rear!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Not yet. Be patient and go at your own pace…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: NOW!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here comes Satono Diamond! What an incredible burst of acceleration in the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond doesn't take first, but she ran a race as glorious as a flawless diamond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, Dia! When did you learn to run like that?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I can't wait to run against you!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow… I've got goosebumps… Satono Diamond ran so well.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She was totally different than she was at the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby! What an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see her run again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My legs feel so… light…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I did it!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My legs were so light today! Even now that I'm done running, I'm not tired at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I finally ran a race I can be satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It feels like shackles have been removed from my legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I feel so light. Not just my body… my mind as well!
choice_data_list: It would appear you've overcome your jinx.
It would appear you've overcome your jinx.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Heh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears begin to trickle from Satono Diamond's eyes. And then…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A hoarse, tearful cry echoes through the runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whispers of a jinx on the Satono family date back before Satono Diamond was ever born. I can only imagine the weight of growing up under such circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps her declaration not to let the jinx get the best of her gave her the push she needed to overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's finally free of its shackles.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Sob… Sorry…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen was right… I was focusing so much on the jinx that it was holding me back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I'm okay now. I won't be led astray again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep running like I did today and prove that I can win more G1 races!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's easier said than done!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nice race today, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I wonder if I've become a worthy rival for you…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's face off in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're o—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Would it be okay if…
choice_data_list: Say no more! Next up is the Arima Kinen!
Say no more! Next up is the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But you'd better prepare yourself! I'm going to be on a completely different level in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But before we race, I'm going to show the whole world the spirit of Japan and what I can do at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And then let's make the Arima Kinen the best race we can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from Kyoto Racecourse…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. My heart hasn't stopped pounding all day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Even now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about running against Kita in the Arima Kinen gets my blood pumping. Is this anticipation, or is it excitement?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I never thought my silly childhood dream would actually come true…
choice_data_list: Your dream of racing against Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I used to imagine us running a G1 race together. But it turns out reality is even more dramatic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now Kita is the rival standing between me and my dream of becoming an illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the most dramatic and exciting destiny I could ask for!
choice_data_list: It sounds like the perfect race.
It sounds like the perfect race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It is. Kita has always been ahead of me, but I'll surpass her and make my dream—the Satono family's dream—come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond shows no signs of hesitation. The vermilion fire in her eyes is burning as fiercely as the time we first met.
choice_data_list: First, we have to win the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right! I have no intention of merely gawking like a starstruck child.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now that I've overcome the jinx, I intend to go out there and pummel Kita and every other senior!
